brief: Parses a .panel file, the interface as text, judges it with a court of four birth-checks, and projects it to RML, HTML or a laid-out panel.
detail: A .panel file declares the projection only, boxes, sizes and colours, never a meaning. It has four kinds, PANEL (exactly one), BOX, TEXT and STYLE, written DEFINE <KIND> <name> ( fields ) RATIONALE "...", with every box named. The court checks closure (known fields and roles), reference resolution (every name a CHILDREN list gives is declared and placed), duplicate declaration and the round trip. IsClean is its verdict, Report and Diagnostics its findings; ToRml, ToHtml and ToPanel refuse a document that is not clean. ToPanel builds a laid-out stzPanel and opens no window. A CHILDREN cycle ends the process in the constructor today; see the warning on init.
receiver: o1 = new stzUiDocument('DEFINE PANEL p ( SIZE [100, 80], CHILDREN [x] ) RATIONALE "boxes only"' + char(10) + 'DEFINE BOX x ( WIDTH 40, HEIGHT 30, SATISFIES [open_it] ) RATIONALE "a box"')
